bio.text: Sam Forstag, a smokejumper and federal employee union leader based in Missoula, is running as a Democrat in 2026 for Montana's 1st Congressional District.
He served as a local chapter vice president of the National Federation of Federal Employees and worked as a lobbyist for the ACLU of Montana in 2021.
A University of Montana graduate, he was president of the university's student government.

sources.title: Forstag Jumps into Democratic Primary for Western House District
